content: Chgapanga kangulongela na bhandu kwa njila ya Mwana ghwake
Pamakachu pala Chgapanga kakilongela patangalo na aghohi bhetu mu njila nhanganganiko kukindila kwa ambuye,
peni mu manjubha agha gha uhiko, Chgapanga kangulongela na twenga kukindila Mwana ghwake. Chgapanga kwa njila ya ywombe kakighubhumba unnima na kakinpegha hilibhi hyoha kahitabhale.

Ywombe ndo ung'anyimo ghwa ukulu ghwa Chgapanga na kangubhoneha bhula Chgapanga pakabheghite. Kanguyambuha hilibhi yoha himamalitane papamu handa payibheghite kwa lilagho lyake liibheghite na makakala. Mbole ya kubhayoha bhandu na kubhabhuhila ulemwa, kakighenda katama kunani mu mbande ya nnilo ya ukulu ghwa Chgapanga.
Mwana ghwa Chgapanga kakitendekwa nkulu kupitingana Andumitumi bha kunani kwa Chgapanga, na lihina lyake lyakapeghitwe na Chgapanga ndo likulu muno kupitingana gha abho andumitumi.
Kiyaha Chgapanga kakinng'ombela ng'obhe nga nndumitumi ghwake ywohele ghwa kunani kukita,
Kangi kakinng'ombela ng'obhe nga nndumitumi ghwake yumu ghwa kunani kukita,
Peni Chgapanga pakabheghite kangunlaghila mwana ghwake ghwa ulongohi mu nnima ndo kakilongela,
Peni kya kualinga andumitumi bhake bha kunani kakilongela,

content.text: “Chgapanga nungubhaghalambula andumitumi bhangu bha kunani abheghe likusi,
Na andumila bhake nungubhaghalambula abheghe mibhale ya mwoto.”

content: Peni kwa kya Mwana ghwake, Chgapanga kakilongela,

content.text: “Ghubhutwa ghwako ghwenga Chgapanga ghwabhegha ghwa manjubha ghoha,
Ghungupala kutenda ghanakunoghela na ghungulema uhakata.
Ya kya agho Chgapanga, Chgapanga ghwako kakuhaghula ghwenga na kughupopohela mahuta gha maha ngati ghubheghe nkulu
na kakupegha ghwenga uhokamo na uyelelo
na kwa mabhoko ghako ghukitendekeha kunani.
Ahyo hyoha hyahobha, peni ghwenga ghwahighala manjubha ghoha,

content: Bhuli Chgapanga kakilongela kwa nndumitumi ghwake ywoki ghwa kunani kukita,

content.text: “Ghutame apa mu mbande yangu ya nnilo
pahi yako handa kiteho kya kulibhatila maghulu.”

content: Andumitumi bha kunani kwa Chapanga ndo aghani? Ndo mihuki yiintendela lihengo Chgapanga na bhalaghilwa na ywombe kuatangatila bhoha bhaapala kukingama ulopohi.
